MOD = 1000000007

K = int(input())
n = int(input())

digits = []
x = n
while x > 0:
    digits.append(x % K)
    x //= K
digits.reverse()

class Result:
    def __init__(self, other=None, rot=None, a=None, b=None):
        if other is not None and rot is not None:
            # Rotation constructor
            self.matrix = [[0]*K for _ in range(K)]
            self.inside = [0]*K
            self.exist = [False]*K
            for i in range(K):
                self.exist[(i + rot) % K] = other.exist[i]
                self.inside[(i + rot) % K] = other.inside[i]
                for j in range(K):
                    self.matrix[(i + rot) % K][(j + rot) % K] = other.matrix[i][j]
        elif a is not None and b is not None:
            # Combination constructor
            self.matrix = [[0]*K for _ in range(K)]
            self.inside = [0]*K
            self.exist = [False]*K
            for i in range(K):
                self.exist[i] = a.exist[i] or b.exist[i]
                self.inside[i] = a.inside[i]
                if not a.exist[i]:
                    self.inside[i] = (self.inside[i] + b.inside[i]) % MOD
                for j in range(K):
                    self.inside[i] = (self.inside[i] + a.matrix[i][j] * b.inside[j]) % MOD
                    self.matrix[i][j] = 0
                    if not b.exist[j]:
                        self.matrix[i][j] = a.matrix[i][j]
                    if not a.exist[i]:
                        self.matrix[i][j] = (self.matrix[i][j] + b.matrix[i][j]) % MOD
                    for m in range(K):
                        self.matrix[i][j] = (self.matrix[i][j] + a.matrix[i][m] * b.matrix[m][j]) % MOD
        else:
            # Default constructor
            self.matrix = [[0]*K for _ in range(K)]
            self.inside = [0]*K
            self.exist = [False]*K

pk = [Result() for _ in range(len(digits))]
for i in range(len(digits)):
    pk[i] = Result()
if len(digits) > 0:
    pk[0].exist[0] = True
    pk[0].inside[0] = 1
    for j in range(K):
        pk[0].matrix[0][j] = 1

for p in range(1, len(digits)):
    pk[p] = pk[p - 1]
    for v in range(1, K):
        pk[p] = Result(a=pk[p], b=Result(a=pk[p - 1], v=v))

res = Result()
sum_digits = 0
for i in range(len(digits) - 1, -1, -1):
    for v in range(digits[i]):
        res = Result(a=res, b=Result(a=pk[i], rot=(sum_digits + v) % K))
    sum_digits += digits[i]

total = 1
for i in range(K):
    total = (total + res.inside[i]) % MOD

print(total)
